**Opening this on `Dev-Jets/devy-interview-task`? Please don't open pull requests there.** (In your own task repo, delete this text and carry on.)

Your task lives in **your own repo**: the `devyai-task-<code>` branch of your fork, or your `devyai-task-<code>` repo made from the template. Devy finds it there by its token in `.devy/task.json`; nothing needs to be merged into `Dev-Jets/devy-interview-task`, and pull requests there are closed automatically.

When you're done, set `"status": "done"` in `.devy/task.json` and push, or tap **I'm done** in Devy.
